audit.summary: The 320×480 ad displays the Kusmi Tea brand identity well with correct logo placement, strong typography hierarchy, and appropriate color use from the style guide. However, there are two findings: (1) pagination dots are visible below the product carousel but the carousel appears to show only a single slide across all three states, which violates the mandatory rule that orphan/single-slide dots must be hidden; (2) the primary CTA button ('J'EN PROFITE') appears to sit very close to or flush against the bottom edge of the ad frame, leaving insufficient safe margin (20 px minimum) from the bottom boundary.

findings.issue: Carousel pagination dots visible with only one distinct slide visible across initial, animated, and settled states. Single-slide carousels must have pagination dots hidden to avoid confusion about navigation capability.
findings.fix_hint: Hide pagination dots when carousel has <= 1 working slide. Add CSS rule: #ad-320x480 .carousel-dots { display: none; } or conditionally hide via JS if slide count ≤ 1.

findings.issue: Primary CTA button ('J'EN PROFITE') appears flush or too close to the bottom edge of the #ad-320x480 frame, violating the 20 px safe zone requirement for footer elements.
findings.fix_hint: Add padding-bottom to #ad-320x480 or increase bottom margin/padding on the CTA button container to ensure at least 20 px clearance from the bottom edge. Example: #ad-320x480 .cta-container { margin-bottom: 20px; } or #ad-320x480 { padding-bottom: 20px; }

audit.regeneration_prompt:
1. Hide carousel pagination dots: add #ad-320x480 .carousel-dots { display: none; } or conditionally hide if slide count ≤ 1 via JS.
2. Increase CTA safe margin: add padding-bottom: 20px to #ad-320x480 or margin-bottom: 20px to the CTA button container to create visible gap from frame bottom.
3. Verify carousel background image paths are correct and product tin images load without 404 errors.
